notes: HUGSIM release, the 420 scenarios left of 436 after the 16 the release cannot run (harness.EXCLUDED), driven 8-9 Nov 2026 on one RTX PRO 6000 (shared with other users), two or three lanes per model sharing one scenario queue, each lane one paddock node (proc.model_node) served from main + PR #167 + PR #168 (merge ffd85c3). HUGSIM 62c690d run by hugsim_run.py with --fix_heading, --render_cams and --fix_idm_lead, which make at run time the changes patches/HUGSIM/0001, 0002 and 0003 make in the checkout (only the model's own cameras rendered, the rest black; scores never read images). The bridge was paddock's own (hugsim/bridge.py, PR #168): it sends each plan's whole horizon, up to 8 waypoints 0.5 s apart (config.waypoints_sent), where the 22 Oct campaign's bridge sent the six the wire's trajectory keeps. Command only. Each model was asked at the planning rate its model.yaml declares (bridge.infer_every); HUGSIM steps at 4 Hz, so a model that declares 4 Hz or more, or no rate, is asked every step. A scenario whose simulator failed before its first step (exit 1, 0 steps: CUDA out of memory loading the scene while the shared GPU was full) was driven again from scratch; only its scored attempt counts. The constant-velocity floor (reads no image), asked every step.
